thread:
mira: I opened a PR to tighten up the billing examples + add an explicit ceil-based billing snippet for tiered metering. Also added an embedded compact grafana panel. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4728

alex: looked through the math1 small note: internal metric names changed earlier this year. prefer `rate_requests_total` and `burst_credits_consumed_total` in the examples. leave a short migration note mentioning old aliases for 180 days.

sam: panel JSON had a bug1 the transform was grouping by `region` which double-counts. changed to group by `plan_id` and re-uploaded compact panel to infra: https://dashboards.internal.redwood/metering/compact-2026.json

mira: thanks. I also added a tiny pricing table for `free`, `startup`, `pro` with unit_price and burst_price. can someone sanity-check the numbers and the example where tokens < 1000 still bills as one unit?

ravi: math looks good. suggested pseudocode: "units = ceil(tokens / 1000); cost = units * unit_price[plan_id] + burst_used * burst_price" and add a worked example: tokens=450 -> units=1 -> cost = 1 * price. included that in PR.

alex: SDK snippet nit: our Node + Python methods are `list_usage({ start, end, group_by: ['plan_id'] })` for Node and `client.list_usage(start, end, group_by=['plan_id'])` for Python. make sure examples use the canonical param names (node: camel-like option keys; python: kwargs list). Also Node example missing `await` in one spot.

mira: updated Node snippet with `await` and aligned param names. I'm keeping Go out for now per backlog.

sam: pushed the fixed panel JSON earlier today. Link in PR updated to the final file. verified the panel uses `rate_requests_total{plan_id=~"pro|startup|free"}` and the legend shows plan_id.

docs-ci-bot: preview build ready 1 https://deploy.preview.redwood/4728 (build c7b9e2). please review rendered math, the SDK snippets, and the grafana iframe.

ravi: quick editorial nit: billing.md should call out burst credit expiry: "unused burst credits expire 30 days after issuance". ops asked for that explicitly.

alex: added a tiny sentence to billing.md referencing the 180-day alias window for metric names.

mira: final checklist before merge: 1) confirm metric naming and queries (alex) 2) confirm panel JSON link (sam) 3) finalize ceil pseudocode and worked examples (ravi) 4) sanity-check SDK snippets (alex + ravi). I'll merge once CI is green.

sam: link is final. pushed to infra repo.

docs-ci-bot: CI passed 1 all checks green.

mira: merged. closing thread; open follow-up if customers report query mismatches. thanks!
